items.name: Meshy
items.version: AI 輔助 3D 工作流程擴展 / 自動分割
items.why: Meshy 於本月擴展了其 AI 輔助 3D 創建工作流程，並推出了「自動分割」功能，能讓 3D 模型在數秒內變得可列印，顯著提升了其在遊戲模組創建中的實用性。
items.why_en: Meshy expanded its AI-assisted 3D creation workflow this month and launched the 'Auto Split' feature, making 3D models printable in seconds, significantly enhancing its utility in game module creation.

items.name: Rodin Gen-2.5
items.why: 於 5 月底發佈，Rodin Gen-2.5 提供了雕塑級的幾何細節、自適應的速度-品質控制以及更可用的拓撲選項，對於需要高保真遊戲資產的開發者極具價值。
items.why_en: Released in late May, Rodin Gen-2.5 offers sculpt-level geometric detail, adaptive speed-quality controls, and more usable topology options, making it highly valuable for developers needing high-fidelity game assets.

items.name: Meshy Workspace 3.0
items.why: 於 5 月中旬發佈，Meshy Workspace 3.0 徹底重建了 AI 3D 創建環境，引入了任務導向的工作流程模組和統一的資產管理，大幅提升了用戶體驗和效率。
items.why_en: Released in mid-May, Meshy Workspace 3.0 completely rebuilt the AI 3D creation environment, introducing task-oriented workflow modules and unified asset management, significantly enhancing user experience and efficiency.

items.name: Meshy-6.5 Auto-Rig + Animate
items.why: 引入增強的面部綁定功能和改進的動畫重定向，顯著提升角色可動性。
items.why_en: Introduced enhanced facial rigging capabilities and improved animation retargeting, significantly boosting character animatability.

items.name: Autodesk Flow Studio Smart Rigging Assistant
items.why: 新的智慧綁定助手功能從預覽版轉為正式發佈，提供更智能的 AI 綁定流程。
items.why_en: New Smart Rigging Assistant feature moved from preview to General Availability, offering a more intelligent AI rigging workflow.

items.name: Tripo Uni-Rig Pro
items.why: 推出 Uni-Rig Pro 版本，提供進階骨骼放置和權重繪製自訂功能，增強專業級控制。
items.why_en: Launched Uni-Rig Pro version, offering advanced bone placement and weight painting customization, enhancing professional-grade control.

items.name: Anything World Animate Anything (Physics & Interaction Update)
items.why: 更新了物理基礎動畫和生成資產互動功能，使動畫更具真實感和動態性。
items.why_en: Updated physics-based animation and interaction with generated assets, making animations more realistic and dynamic.

items.name: Cascadeur 2026.1.1
items.why: 本月最新發佈的維護更新，主要針對性能改進、錯誤修復和穩定性增強。
items.why_en: Latest maintenance update released this month, focusing on performance improvements, bug fixes, and stability enhancements.

items.why_en: Launched real-time, full-duplex voice models, significantly enhancing the naturalness and immediacy of human-AI voice interaction.
